• Author of 5 #1 NYT/WSJ bestsellers (e.g., The 4-Hour Workweek) • Host of The Tim Ferriss Show podcast • Click the link for my free newsletter👇

New podcast episode on The Tim Ferriss Show is up! “HOW TO SIMPLIFY YOUR LIFE” I’ve gathered practical insights from @chipconley, @gregorymckeown, David Allen, @elizabeth_gilbert_writer, and @oliverburkeman_. Episode #885 is out now. Listen at the link in my bio or wherever you get your podcasts. Please enjoy!
“This should be the country where the most talented people in the world are coming to right now.” — Kevin Ryan
How I spent time this weekend.
“Would you be more comfortable in another language?” How AI agents are changing customer support.
Being busy is a form of laziness—lazy thinking and indiscriminate action.

NEW podcast episode is up! “How to Legalize Medical Psychedelics in Your Country — Tania de Jong on The Playbook Behind Australia’s World-First Breakthrough” My guest today is Tania de Jong (@TaniadeJongam), co-founder of Mind Medicine Australia (@mindmedicine.au). Tania and her husband, Peter, helped lead the push that, in 2023, made Australia the first country in the world to allow MDMA and psilocybin to be prescribed for psychiatric conditions. I wanted to understand how the hell they helped make that happen and what the rest of the world can learn from it. Please enjoy!
Do not overestimate the competition and underestimate yourself. You are better than you think.
Why you need to workshop your ideas in person.
I hope you enjoy the following gems as much as I have…
